text:
maria_cs: Quick check-in on OpalCloud (CUST-OPAL) week2 private deploy — can we do a short status + risk call? I noticed the preflight flagged a KMS key policy mismatch and audit-log retention gap.

alex_infra: Blocking item for infra: their egress rules only allow outbound to specific IPs. We need 10.0.32.0/24 -> Redwood egress (443, 22) and a NAT gateway confirmed. Snippet for what we need from their side:```bash
# example (customer-run)
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0abc123 --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.0.32.0/24
```

devon_eng: Runtime checks done — KV/cache behavior looks fine for their workload. We validated model pin to redwood/gpt-small-v1.4 and perf is OK at their target QPS. Recommend quantized profile for cost; I'll open a dedicated-serving profile PR.

julie_pm: Heads up — if cutover slips more than ~30 days we surface as a renewal-risk to GTM. @maria_cs can you confirm go/no-go date by EOD Friday so we can escalate or de-escalate? :warning:

sam_customer: Quick answers from our side: NAT gateway will be in place by tomorrow morning. Compliance requires audit logs retained for 13 months (not 90). Also we need HSM-backed keys / BYOK for KMS rotation — can you confirm Redwood supports CMAK/CMEK with HSM?

security_bot: Automated scan result for CUST-OPAL: KMS key "opal-prod-key" policy missing explicit grant for service principal `redwood-vpc@ops.redwood.ai` — missing permission: kms:Encrypt. Severity: medium. Action: update key policy or add a grant.

alex_infra: I'll update the key policy tonight. Quick Q for @sam_customer — do you want us to provision a CloudKMS key (customer-managed in their project) or will you provide a BYOK ARN? If BYOK, pls paste the ARN here once available.

sam_customer: We prefer BYOK with HSM. I'll get the KMS ARN from our security team and drop it here by EOD.

maria_cs: Thanks — I'll add this to the enablement checklist and schedule a run-through with ops. Proposed slot: Thursday 2pm PT for a cutover dry-run and fallback walkthrough. Note for docs: customer asked explicitly for a simple fallback runbook that switches to hosted API + token TTL guidance.

devon_eng: I'll add a short fallback snippet and a canary step to the runbook. Example to include:```json
{
  "fallback": "use-hosted-endpoint",
  "steps": ["limit traffic to 5%", "monitor latency/error-rate for 10m", "switch to 25%"]
}
``` PR to follow — will paste link here when ready.

maria_cs: Putting this account in 'at-risk' for renewal until we confirm cutover schedule (per Julie's note). I'll send calendar invite after we get KMS ARN. Also capturing feedback: they want clearer runbook sections for rollback and SLA expectations.

alex_infra: Noted. I'll queue the key-policy change and confirm once deployed. :thumbsup:

sam_customer: Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll update when I have the ARN.

maria_cs: Great — keeping this thread open. If anything else pops up ping me here or DM.
